grammar.summary: 本课学习被动语态的算账叙事与 not...for nothing 结构。

points.title: be + V-ed 被动的量化叙事
points.explanation: In one year, spiders have been known to destroy... 完成时被动表"有记载以来"。数字场景的被动让"蜘蛛"成为叙事主语。

examples.en: They have been known to destroy as many as a hundred million insects in one year.
examples.cn: 已知它们一年最多能消灭一亿只昆虫。

points.title: how much 表"多少"的感叹问句
points.explanation: How much do we owe spiders? 感叹式提问表对蜘蛛贡献的"清点"，owe sb. sth. 表亏欠。

examples.en: How much do we owe spiders?

points.title: not...for nothing 的强调
points.explanation: They have been doing this for nothing? 否定词与 for nothing 连用表"绝非徒劳/绝不是白来的"。

examples.en: But spiders never do the least harm to us.
